title: Freeway provider spec
description: One free-tier API provider, as data. Adding a provider means dropping one of these into providers/ and setting an env var — never editing TypeScript. Files whose name starts with _ are skipped by the loader, which is why this schema can live here.

id.description: Short slug. Becomes the first half of every model ref, e.g. `groq/llama-3.3-70b`.

label.description: Human name for the dashboard. Defaults to id.

docs.description: API docs URL, linked from the provider card.

console.description: Where to get a key. Linked as 'get a key' on unconfigured cards.

priority.description: Lower is tried first under the `priority` strategy.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base, e.g. https://api.groq.com/openai/v1. May contain ${ENV_VAR}, which is how providers that embed an account id in the URL stay pure data.

type.description: bearer → Authorization: Bearer <key>. header → a named header. query → a query param. none → no credential (a local Ollama).

header.description: Header name when type is `header`, e.g. x-api-key.

query.description: Query param name when type is `query`, e.g. key.

prefix.description: Overrides the `Bearer ` prefix. Set "" for a bare token.

envKeys.description: Env vars to read keys from, in order. ONE variable may hold several comma-separated keys — that is the key pool, and quota is tracked per key.

limits.description: Free-tier ceilings. null means unknown or unlimited and is ALWAYS better than a guess — the guard layer overwrites nulls with values learned from upstream rate-limit headers.

creditsPerDay.description: Abstract metered unit per day — Cloudflare bills free Workers AI in neurons.

creditsPerRequest.description: Fallback flat credit cost when a model has no per-token rates.

limitsSource.description: Where the numbers above came from. Use `unverified` honestly — the dashboard badges it and nothing breaks.

verifiedOn.description: ISO date the limits were last checked, e.g. 2026-08-16.

modelsEndpoint.description: Path for live model discovery, relative to baseUrl. null disables it (Cloudflare's OpenAI surface has no /models).

modelsPath.description: Where ids live in the discovery response. Tiny grammar: `data[].id`, `models[].name`, `[].id`, `result[].name`. This is what keeps a non-OpenAI response shape a JSON edit.

dropParams.description: Body params this provider rejects; stripped before forwarding. Find them by sending a request and reading the 400.

headers.description: Extra request headers. Values may contain ${ENV_VAR}.

notes.description: Anything the next reader needs — signup friction, quirks, why a number is what it is.

models.description: Seed models. Prefer a handful you have actually verified over a long list you have not; live discovery fills in the rest.

id.description: Upstream model id, exactly as the provider spells it. May contain slashes.

alias.description: Short names clients can route by. Several providers sharing an alias is the point — that is what makes failover work.

context.description: Context window in tokens. null when unpublished; the context engine then assumes a conservative default.

caps.description: Drives routing. A request with `tools` only goes to models declaring `tools`. `embed` models never serve chat and vice versa.

credits.description: Per-model credit rates. Output tokens typically cost 7-10x input, and a big model ~10x a small one, so one flat number per provider is wrong by an order of magnitude.
